about: Deliberate one-place faults for the problem-clearing cases in Tests/DirectDragAppChecks/ProblemClearCases.swift. Each entry replaces 'old' (which must occur exactly once in 'file') with 'new'; 'red' lists the case ids that must then print UNIT-A FAIL. Applied only by Tests/Mutants/apply.py on the diagnostic CI job, never committed applied.
